api.heading: API settings
api.subheading: Set up a model service first; Cyrene will use it for chat and status checks later.

profileList.title: Saved profiles
profileList.subtitle: Click a profile to load it for editing; switch between profiles in the model panel of the chat window.

presetRow.label: New profile · Choose a provider preset

customEndpoint.title: Custom endpoint
customEndpoint.summary: Connect a cloud service that follows the OpenAI or Anthropic protocol; capabilities are decided by the service provider.

overrides.title: Custom endpoint overrides
overrides.subtitle: Only applies when the current provider is a custom endpoint.

disableMaxToken.title: Remove max_token limit
disableMaxToken.desc: Removes the max_token limit from all requests; suited to local models.

enableThinking.title: Force enable model thinking
enableThinking.desc: Forces the model into thinking mode.

disableThinking.title: Force disable model thinking
disableThinking.desc: Forces the model to skip outputting its thinking process.

editor.title: New profile
editor.subtitle: The nickname tells apart configurations that share a model name but use different APIs; the context window and multimodal setting follow the profile and take effect automatically when you switch profiles in the chat window.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.hint: Enter the API key created on the matching platform

transport.label: API protocol
transport.hint: Choose the interface type your provider actually offers (chat/completion / anthropic / Responses); the app will not detect the protocol automatically.

model.label: Model name
model.contextWindowHint: Saved per profile; leave empty to use 256000.

multimodal.title: Multimodal (can send images directly)
multimodal.desc: When on, images go straight to this model; when off, they are described by the vision model below. Applies per profile.

api.noteText: Choosing a model preset fills in the provider, base URL, and model name automatically; you only need to enter the API key for that platform. The configuration is saved only in your local Electron user data directory.

vision.title: Vision model (global)
vision.desc: When a profile has multimodal off, this standalone vision model describes images instead. Leave it empty and Cyrene will honestly say she can't see them.
vision.hint: ⓘ This model must support the OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint and image_url multimodal input

preferences.heading: Preferences
preferences.subheading: Set the default behavior when the chat window opens. Your choices here are saved as global defaults.

chatMode.title: Default mode
chatMode.desc: The mode used by default when the chat window opens; you can still switch temporarily inside the window.

segmented.title: Segmented output
segmented.desc: Controls how Cyrene's replies are split into segments in the chat bubble; it does not change the model's actual reply content.

mobileSeg.title: Mobile message segmentation
mobileSeg.desc: Replies sent to your phone are split at 。！？； into several messages; please turn this on after disabling tool use.

customStyle.title: Custom style
customStyle.desc: Configure the sampling parameters for the chat window's "custom" style, or open the custom prompt file.

proactive.title: Proactive chat
proactive.desc: Cyrene will start conversations at suitable times; she will not interrupt you late at night when you are inactive, during a normal chat, or after two consecutive unanswered messages.

delivery.title: Send proactive messages to
delivery.desc: When the phone channel is unavailable, that proactive message is cancelled and will not be rerouted locally.

moments.title: Moments
moments.desc: Enable the Moments feature; when off, Cyrene stops posting, liking and commenting, and chats no longer reference Moments content.

posting.title: Cyrene posts Moments
posting.desc: After a conversation ends, Cyrene posts the moments worth recording as a Moment; at most 2 per day, at least 6 hours apart.

reactions.title: Cyrene reacts to Moments
reactions.desc: Cyrene likes and comments on your Moments, and replies to messages left for her in the comment section.

character.title: Character Moments
character.desc: Resident characters such as Long Night's Moon and Mydei also browse Moments, liking, commenting and chatting with each other as their personalities dictate; the daily model call limit scales with the liveliness setting.

liveliness.title: Moments liveliness
liveliness.desc: Controls how many characters see each Moment: when quiet, occasionally nobody responds; when lively, almost every Moment gets attention.

chatSocial.title: Chat context enhancement
chatSocial.desc: Uses relevant past information and open topics in Chat mode only, making continuous conversation more natural; at most one extra asynchronous model call per turn.

cita.title: CITA context awareness
cita.desc: Helps Cyrene understand cross-turn state, references and omitted expressions.

engine.title: Semantic cognition method
engine.desc: The local semantic model will be available in a future version.

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.subheading: Adjust the window layout of the light UI and how Cyrene's desktop pet is displayed.

layout.title: Layout
layout.desc: Choose how Cyrene, chat, status, and schedule windows are organized.

multiWindow.title: Multiple windows
multiWindow.desc: Each feature uses its own window

personalize.title: Personalization
personalize.desc: Fonts and icons apply immediately; only import font files you have the right to use.

windowCornerRadius.title: Window corner radius
windowCornerRadius.desc: Adjust the corner radius of all app windows (0 ~ 40px).

chatLineHeight.title: Line spacing
chatLineHeight.desc: Adjust the line height of text inside message bubbles (1.2 ~ 2.0).

assistantBubble.title: Cyrene reply bubble
assistantBubble.desc: When off, Cyrene's regular replies appear as plain text without a background; user message bubbles are always kept.

chatParaSpacing.title: Paragraph spacing
chatParaSpacing.desc: Adjust the spacing between paragraphs inside message bubbles (0.2 ~ 1.2em).

uiIcon.title: Desktop icon
uiIcon.desc: Switch the system tray and app window icons.

pet.title: Cyrene desktop pet
pet.desc: Control the Live2D desktop pet's window layer, visibility, and size.

alwaysOnTop.title: Keep pet on top
alwaysOnTop.desc: Only the desktop pet stays on top; chat and side windows are not pinned.

visible.title: Pet visibility
visible.desc: Hide or show the Live2D desktop pet itself.

zoom.title: Pet zoom
zoom.desc: Adjust the Live2D model size (0.5× ~ 2.0×); the window scales with the model.

general.heading: General settings
general.subheading: Control the status bar, the schedule bar, basic audio, and system behavior.

statusBar.title: Status bar window
statusBar.desc: If you close it by accident, you can reopen it from here.

tasksBar.title: Schedule bar window
tasksBar.desc: Controls the schedule/task display window on the right.

toastSound.title: Notification sound
toastSound.desc: The chime from the popup in the bottom-right corner when Cyrene is waiting for your confirmation or a task has finished.

launchAtLogin.title: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.desc: Opens Cyrene automatically when the system starts.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Only Chinese is supported for now; other languages are still in development.

disableGpu.title: Disable client GPU rendering
disableGpu.desc: Adds the --disable-gpu flag to Electron to use software rendering, lowering the client's GPU load but increasing CPU load.
disableGpu.descLink2: to see whether GPU rendering is currently in use.
disableGpu.notice: fully quit and restart the client

about.title: About
about.desc: · A lightweight emotional companion desktop agent

cyrene.heading: Cyrene settings
cyrene.subheading: Manage Cyrene's agent behavior, status updates, stickers, memory, and local retrieval capabilities here.

runtimeSync.title: Real-Time status bar updates
runtimeSync.desc: Controls how status and mood are synced to the status bar.
runtimeSync.note: LLM mode makes one extra model call per turn, producing extra token usage.

sticker.title: Sticker sending
sticker.desc: Controls whether Cyrene sends stickers in the chat box, and how large stickers are displayed.

threshold.title: Similarity threshold
threshold.desc: The lower the value, the easier it is to trigger a sticker; the higher the value, the more precise the match

embedding.title: RAG / Document import
embedding.desc: Choose the local retrieval model, later used for file import, world book, and long-term memory recall.
embedding.bgem3Desc: Excellent Chinese performance; supports semantic sticker matching and scene tone injection.
embedding.dimHint: Empty = auto-detect on first request; filled = strict validation
embedding.rerankBaseDesc: Precise reranking, suited to long documents and professional retrieval, about 200ms per pair.
embedding.rerankOffDesc: No reranking; retrieval results are used directly.
embedding.note: These buttons are UI placeholders for now; installer-selectable models, model status detection, and document import retrieval will be wired up later.

memory.heading: Cyrene's memory
memory.subheading: What Cyrene knows and remembers about you. You can view, edit, and manage it.

l0.title: Long-Term profile
l0.desc: Information Cyrene always remembers and that rarely changes
l0.hint: Manual edits take priority over automatic inference

l1.title: Recent status
l1.desc: Recent goals, preferences, and status that change over time
l1.hint: Manual edits take priority over automatic inference

l2.title: Event snippets
l2.desc: Important events distilled from chats; searchable and manageable
l2.emptyHint: Cyrene distills important information automatically after you chat

imported.title: Imported knowledge
imported.desc: Documents and knowledge bases you have uploaded
imported.emptyHint: Files are indexed automatically after you upload them in the chat window

reflection.title: Reflections
reflection.desc: Periodic reflections generated automatically by AI
reflection.emptyHint: Generated automatically as you keep chatting

obsidian.title: Obsidian vault binding
obsidian.desc: Bind a folder to sync memories into .md files connected with [[bidirectional links]]
obsidian.hint: Open the bound folder in Obsidian to see the graph view
obsidian.autoSync: Auto sync (write automatically 2 seconds after memories change)

user.heading: My information
user.subheading: Your personal identity and cloud account (coming soon)
user.avatarHint: Supports JPG and PNG; a 1:1 ratio is recommended
user.fieldHint: This information tells Cyrene how to address you and where you are. The default city is used by tools that need a location, such as weather; the time zone is only used for time calculations and does not indicate your city.

tasks.heading: Scheduled tasks
tasks.subheading: Manage automatically triggered agent tasks. When the time comes, the prompt is used to call the currently allowed tools.
tasks.listHint: Task changes are saved immediately; no need to click the global save button.
tasks.empty: No scheduled tasks yet. Create one to let Cyrene run a prompt automatically on schedule.
tasks.enabledDesc: When off, it will not trigger automatically, but you can still run it manually at any time.
tasks.toolLimitDesc: When on, only the tools selected below can be called; this does not bypass the plugin global switches.
tasks.toolEmptyHint: With no tools selected, the task can only use the model's own abilities and will not call any tools.

channels.heading: Connect your phone
channels.subheading: Connect Cyrene to chat platforms such as WeChat and Feishu. Every user on an external channel gets their own session context and memory.
channels.wechatHint2: (the official personal WeChat access channel), connecting directly to WeChat with no external gateway needed.
channels.wechatHint3: Click "scan to sign in" to open a QR code window inside Cyrene; it connects automatically once you scan the code.
channels.wechatQrTitle: Sign in to WeChat with QR Code
channels.wechatQrTip: Scan the QR code with WeChat to sign in
channels.feishuHint1: Receives messages over the official Feishu SDK's
channels.feishuHint2: (no public network access or NAT traversal required).
channels.feishuHint4: to create a custom app → enable the "bot" capability → enter the app ID/Secret below → then enable it.
channels.qqHint1: Cyrene listens for a reverse WebSocket on windows, and NapCat connects as a WebSocket client.
channels.qqHint2: Group chats only respond to @ mentions in allowlisted groups; group chats share personal memory but have tools forcibly disabled, so only add trusted groups.
channels.qqListenAuto: Auto (prefer WSL, fall back to loopback)
channels.qqBotHint1: Create a bot at q.qq.com and enter its AppID / AppSecret. The official protocol carries zero ban risk, but only supports passive replies
channels.qqBotHint2: (private chats: 4 messages per 60 minutes, group chats: 5 per 5 minutes, no proactive messages); group chats only respond to @ mentions in allowlisted groups.
channels.qqBotHint3: New bots start in sandbox mode, so you need to add test users on the open platform first.
channels.contextHint: Pick an external chat that recently received messages and an existing desktop session. Once bound, both sides continue with the same text context; the external channel's tool permissions are not changed.
channels.toolPermissionOffDesc: Uses Chat: chat only, no tools are invoked.
channels.toolPermissionAllDesc: Uses CyreneHarness: every phone-side tool runs directly, with no confirmation cards or per-item approvals.

plugins.heading: Tool configuration
plugins.subheading: Manage the tools Cyrene can call; when disabled, the scheduling layer will not use that tool.

weather.title: Weather lookup
weather.desc: Look up real-time weather and forecasts for a given city. Open-Meteo needs no setup, or use Amap (
weather.sourceAmap: Amap weather (requires key, accurate in China)
weather.amapHint: Amap open platform → console → application management → create a "web service" type key.
weather.hint: Open-Meteo works out of the box with no setup. Set the default city in the "my info" panel.

travel.title: Amap travel
travel.desc: Look up route planning and estimated times for driving/walking/cycling/transit. Requires an Amap key (
travel.hint: Amap open platform → console → application management → create a "web service" type key. Shares the same key as weather lookup.

search.title: Web search
search.desc: Lets Cyrene search the internet for real-time information. Pick a search provider and fill in the matching key.
search.hint: Pick a search provider and fill in the matching key. MiniMax requires uvx (Python) to be installed first.

email.title: Email sending
email.desc: Send emails over SMTP, with optional attachments. Enter your mailbox SMTP authorization code (not your login password).
email.smtpSecureHint: Usually checked for port 465, unchecked for 587
email.hint: QQ mail → settings → account → enable SMTP → get authorization code; the same goes for 163/Gmail.

file.title: Local files
file.note: Read-only: Cyrene will not modify any local files.

playwright.title: Browser automation (Playwright)
playwright.desc: Lets her click through web pages, fill in forms, take screenshots, and run UI flows. Uses the system's built-in edge browser, with no extra download needed.

music.title: Music tools
music.desc: NetEase cloud music and local music.
music.neteaseDesc: Scan the QR code to log in, then search for and play songs.

music.neteaseSubtitle: Scan the QR code to sign in, then search for songs and play them with the built-in mpv player.

openapi.title: OpenAPI configuration
openapi.hint: Enter the appId and privateKey issued by the NetEase cloud music open platform to call the OpenAPI.

music.playerHint: A card-style player with playlist switching, search, and lyrics display.
music.qrScan: Scan with the NetEase cloud music app
music.qrTip: Scan the QR code with the NetEase cloud music app to sign in
music.searchHint: Connect to NetEase cloud music to search songs and get daily recommendations.
music.searchEmpty: Connect to NetEase cloud music to search songs and get daily recommendations.

section2.title: 2. Scope of use and prohibited conduct
section2.p1: The project is for personal, local, private use only. Any commercial use is strictly prohibited, including but not limited to selling the program, profiting from livestreams, running paid communities, commercial promotion and monetization, and falsely claiming to others that this program is an official product.
section2.p2: The stickers in the program are personally collected assets, for personal local use only; bulk distribution or circulation to others is prohibited.

section3.title: 3. User responsibility
section3.p1: Users bear sole responsibility for the content of their conversations with the AI.

section4.title: 4. No-Warranty statement

section4.p2: This software is provided "as is", without any express or implied warranty.

The character personas and personalities are fictional settings and are not real individuals. AI output has no real emotions, self-awareness, or subjective intent.

tts.heading: TTS settings
tts.autoReadDesc: Cyrene reads every reply aloud automatically
tts.splitEnabledDesc: Read chunks aloud while the reply is being generated; turn it off to wait for the full reply first
tts.splitModeDesc: Read sentence by sentence, or read whole paragraphs separated by blank lines
tts.speedDesc: Controls how fast the voice reads
tts.streamingDesc: Synthesize and play at the same time, with low latency to the first sound (on by default). Turn off = wait for the full audio, then play.
tts.vocalEnhanceDesc: Automatically inserts MiniMax voice tags such as laughter, breaths, and sighs to make the speech sound more natural.
tts.minimaxCloneHint: Upload a Cyrene voice recording (mp3/m4a/wav, 10 seconds to 5 minutes, ≤20MB) to train a dedicated voice
tts.gptsovitsPromptText: Text that matches the reference audio
tts.mosslandHint: Built on Mossland cloud TTS (api.mosi.cn). Bearer auth; POST /v1/audio/speech to synthesize; POST /v1/audio/voices to clone; GET /v1/audio/voices to fetch the list.
tts.mosslandCloneHint: Upload a clear single-speaker reference audio and Mossland creates a voice_id via multipart/form-data.
tts.mosslandCloneWarning: The voice_id is returned by the Mossland backend; paste it into the "voice ID" field above to reuse it. For the validity period and account quota, refer to the Mossland console.
tts.mosslandVoiceListHint: Fetch the voices already created under your account from the Mossland server, and fill one into the "voice ID" field above with a single click.
tts.ttsHint: 💡 MiniMax requires training a voice in the console and filling in the voice ID. GPT-SoVITS requires you to run a local service yourself and provide reference audio. Custom cloud POSTs a fixed JSON body to your endpoint. Xiaomi MiMo currently uses Cyrene's reference audio for non-streaming wav synthesis via voiceclone. Mossland uploads the clone audio via multipart to POST /v1/audio/voices and returns a voice_id.

asr.heading: ASR settings
asr.engineHint: Alibaba cloud supports real-time interim results; Mossland returns the full text after each speaking turn ends.
asr.aliyunHint: Alibaba cloud → intelligent speech interaction console → create a project to get the AppKey. Get the AccessKey in the RAM access control console (ram.console.aliyun.com/manage/ak). The token is fetched automatically, so there is no need to fill it in manually.
asr.mosslandHint: Shares the same API key as Mossland TTS. Audio is uploaded to moss-transcribe after VAD determines the current turn has ended; no real-time interim subtitles are provided.
asr.vadSilenceHint: How long a pause after the user speaks before the turn counts as finished. If someone takes their time finding words, set it larger (e.g. 3000); if they respond quickly, set it smaller (e.g. 800). Default is 1000ms.
asr.vadThresholdHint: Lower it when the microphone volume is low or the room is quiet (e.g. 0.005); raise it in noisy surroundings. Default is 0.01.
asr.showTranscriptHint: When enabled, the call window shows the live recognized text and Cyrene's replies
